note: All R² values are for the score alone — covariates are fitted but excluded from the evaluated prediction, per the package's accuracy definition — so the genetic-value oracle sits below h2 whenever covariates carry phenotypic variance. cv_r2 is the nested-CV estimate on the training split only; uplift is multi_r2 minus best_single_r2 per replicate. null_model_mean is the rate at which the nested gate withheld the penalized model.
